instruction: The function `slugify` in slug.py should lowercase the text, replace every run of non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen, and strip leading/trailing hyphens. It currently fails on several inputs. Fix slug.py so test_slug.py passes. Do not modify the tests.

parse_duration in duration.py should accept strings like '90s', '5m', '2h', '1h30m' and return the total number of seconds as an int. Unknown formats must raise ValueError. Implement it so test_duration.py passes. Do not modify the tests.

The running-average class in stats.py loses precision and crashes on an empty stream. Fix it so test_stats.py passes: mean() on an empty Average must raise ValueError, and adding values must not accumulate float error across many updates. Do not modify the tests.

merge_configs in config.py must deep-merge two nested dicts: values from the override win, nested dicts merge recursively, and neither input may be mutated. Fix it so test_config.py passes. Do not modify the tests.

files.config.py:
def merge_configs(base, override):
    result = base
    result.update(override)
    return result

instruction: truncate_words in text.py should cut a string to at most n words and append an ellipsis character only when it actually truncated. It currently miscounts and always appends. Fix text.py so test_text.py passes. Do not modify the tests.

Add a `retries` option to fetch_with_retry in retry.py: on a raised exception it should retry up to `retries` additional times, then re-raise the last exception. It must not sleep. Implement it so test_retry.py passes. Do not modify the tests.
